adminProviders.listEmptyDesc: After you add a general or media model, it appears here sorted into primary and backup.

adminProviders.endpointModelHint: One node serves exactly one model; add another node to serve a different one (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, deepseek-v3).
adminProviders.setPrimaryHint: Saving will automatically demote the current primary of the same kind to backup.
adminProviders.demotedNotice: Automatically demoted {count} previous primary node(s) to backup
adminProviders.mediaModelNameHint: The model id sent to the provider's API (e.g. gpt-image-1, doubao-seedance-1-0-pro).

adminProviders.generationKindHint: Edit-class models only enter video-creation routing when a video source is already attached. Create-class models can generate from text or a still.
adminProviders.serviceProviderHint: A shortcut only — picking a provider narrows the model field below to its known catalogue and pre-fills base URL/protocol/modalities. Everything stays hand-editable, and "Custom" behaves exactly as before this picker existed.
adminProviders.knownModelHint: Picking one overwrites the base URL/protocol/modalities fields below with that model's real supported values, and pre-fills pricing from that model's own page (an already-saved price is never overwritten just by reopening this form).
adminProviders.knownModelEmpty: This provider has no known models of this type yet — use the fields below to enter one by hand.
adminProviders.mediaModelRequired: A media model must have an invocation model name.
adminProviders.modalitiesHint: Check the input and output types this model supports — the generation capabilities it can serve are derived from that combination.
adminProviders.derivedCapabilitiesEmpty: This combination maps to no capability yet — adjust your selection.
adminProviders.modalitiesRequired: The selected input/output combination does not map to any capability. Please choose again.
adminProviders.generalModalitiesHint: Text is always supported and needs no toggle. Checking image/video means the model can also understand image/video input; checking video makes this model eligible for video-analysis routing.
adminProviders.removeModelDesc: Once removed, this model stops receiving traffic. It can be restored by adding it again.
adminProviders.validateMediaDescription: This sends one real generation request. It can take tens of seconds and may incur a charge. It cannot be cancelled from this page once sent.
adminProviders.validationWarningCancel: The video task was created, but automatic cancellation failed
adminProviders.validationErrorNoModel: The provider returned no model to test
adminProviders.validationErrorNoCapability: No testable media capability is configured

adminProviders.validationErrorAccess: Provider access was denied; check H3 entitlement, balance, region/IP, and account status
adminProviders.validationErrorRejected: The provider rejected the test request
adminProviders.validationErrorInvalidResponse: The provider returned an invalid response
adminProviders.pricingGeneralHint: Enter the vendor's list price in USD or CNY. CNY is converted at the form rate and saved as USD. Blank means unknown, not free.
adminProviders.pricingFxRateHint: CNY per 1 USD. Used only for this conversion — not saved to config.
adminProviders.fxRateInvalid: Enter a rate greater than 0, e.g. 7.2.
adminProviders.pricingNeedsModalities: Choose the output types first — pricing follows what this model can produce.
adminProviders.pricingImageHint: Priced per image, with input images billed separately from generated ones.
adminProviders.pricingAudioHint: Priced per character, usually quoted per 10,000 characters.
adminProviders.pricingMusicHint: Priced per generated clip — one flat cost per call, regardless of length or character count.
adminProviders.pricingVideoHint: Priced per second at each output resolution. Input material is billed separately, and reference images cost extra beyond the free allowance.
adminProviders.pricingInvalid: Enter a plain number without symbols, e.g. 0.00286.
adminProviders.tokenCountInvalid: Enter a number, optionally with a K/M suffix, e.g. 128K or 1M.
adminProviders.contextLengthHint: The vendor's stated maximum context in tokens. Display only. Accepts a K/M suffix, e.g. 128K or 1M.
adminProviders.maxOutputTokensHint: The vendor's stated maximum output tokens per call. Display only. Accepts a K/M suffix, e.g. 128K or 1M.
adminProviders.priceCachedInputTokensHint: {currency} per million tokens — a prompt-cache hit rate, usually below the regular input rate. The gateway does not yet parse a cache-hit count out of the upstream response, so this price is recorded but not yet applied to billing.
adminProviders.priceImageGenerationFlatHint: {currency} per image. A per-tier price below takes priority when set.
adminProviders.imageFreeReferenceCountHint: Reference images beyond this count are billed at the "Image input" rate above. 0 (the default) bills every input image.
adminProviders.videoFreeReferenceImagesHint: Reference images beyond this count are billed at the rate below.
adminProviders.pricingVideoTokenHint: Some vendors bill by video tokens (a duration x width x height x frame-rate formula) instead of a flat per-second rate, with two rates depending on whether the request attaches a video reference. Fill in either this section or the per-second fields above, not both.

adminWorkflows.dryRunDesc: Submits a real generation job through the full pipeline: node progress lands in job ops, and a successful output enters content review. Credits are not charged. Defaults to the unpublished draft on this canvas; you can switch to the published live graph. Requires the worker (including Beat).
adminWorkflows.validationWarnings: These do not block publishing — confirm they are intentional
adminWorkflows.agentSelectHint: Which agent runs this node (prompt slot: {slot}). Only agents whose role this node accepts are listed.
adminWorkflows.agentLoadFailed: Could not load agents; the current value is kept as is.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_safety_check_desc: Content-safety veto. A rejection here cannot be overridden by any downstream node.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_skill_context_desc: When the request carries a skill_id, merges that creation skill's parameter template into the working params and records one use.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_planning_desc: Breaks the user's intent down into an executable generation plan.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_intent_router_desc: Uses a cheap general agent to judge how complex the request is. It may only lower the quality tier, feeds a hint to routing, and never affects billing.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_custom_agent_desc: Runs a judgment agent created in the console and parks its structured verdict in workflow state for later nodes. Settles no credits and moves no job state.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_copy_generate_desc: Runs the copy agent to produce title/description/tags. With follow-up questions enabled, a sparse prompt suspends the job for single/multi/free-text answers instead of emitting copy.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_route_score_desc: Filters candidate providers by hard rules and hands the survivors to the routing agent. Re-entry is capped by max_attempts.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_provider_generate_desc: Makes one generation attempt against the selected provider. Checks for cancellation, and takes retry rather than failed unless retries are turned off.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_video_analysis_generate_desc: Makes one parsing attempt against the selected video-understanding provider. On success, writes the structured analysis result directly and settles the full credit amount — no output asset is registered and no quality check runs.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_quality_check_desc: Judges whether the output is good enough. On pass, registers the asset and settles the actual credits.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_asset_planning_desc: Plans the prompt for a character view/scene/cover image, keeping the same character consistent across views; a no-op when asset_kind is empty or general.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_asset_output_advance_desc: Registers this round's output asset; if asset_kind=character and character_views still has views left, loops back to the image asset planning node for the next one, otherwise passes through to asset auto-attach.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_asset_output_link_desc: Attaches a quality-passed image to the target character skill or scene library; a no-op when asset_kind is empty or general, or when there is no output asset.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_join_desc: Joins the branches of a fan-out: barrier needs every branch to succeed, race needs only one.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_settle_success_desc: The only node type allowed to capture credits and move the job to a successful terminal state.
adminWorkflows.nodeType_fail_desc: The only node type allowed to release the reservation and move the job to a failed terminal state.
adminWorkflows.customAgentRoleHint: Judgment roles only. The role decides what kind of judgment this node runs; changing it resets the agent and slot below.
adminWorkflows.customAgentSlotHint: A role can own several system prompts that share no instructions. This picks which one the node uses.
adminWorkflows.discardChangesDesc: The edits on this canvas have not been published and will be lost.
adminWorkflows.engineFailureHotspotHint: This node hit a workflow engine failure on real jobs recently — the graph may be structurally valid but misconfigured.
adminWorkflows.dryRunSourceDraftHint: A dry run publishes nothing and creates no version. A draft is validated exactly like a publish first.
adminWorkflows.dryRunDurationHint: MiniMax H3 accepts 4–15 seconds; the default is 8.
adminWorkflows.dryRunParamsHint: Sent as job parameters alongside the prompt — e.g. '{"skill_id": "ck_..."}' to exercise the creation-skill branch.
adminWorkflows.dryRunParamsHintVideo: Duration is chosen above. Other parameters can go in JSON, e.g. a creation skill.
